pair_schedule: p=(zero_based_step//12)%8; fields 80+2p,81+2p; same rest/current geometry as original step

calibration.eta: per resolution max(1e-4, median rest train pair/channel single-label contrast-noise squared / midpoint pair-mean action squared); noise=(r0-r1)/sqrt(2)
calibration.lambda: .25 * median original deformation loss / median new directional loss; untrained seed5901; tr00,tr04,tr08,tr11 crossed with all8pairs; no optimizer step

loss: Average rest/current and coarse/fine16 and RGB: ||pred(a)-pred(b)-(target(a)-target(b))||² / (||target(a)-target(b)||²+eta_resolution*||.5*(target(a)+target(b))||²+1e-20). Original r0 targets only.

independent.qualification: all24 total contrast pair/channels SNR>=3; else limited/inconclusive independent confirmation; no extra sampling

evaluation.original: Unchanged WL59 evaluate.py, all rest/primary/diagnostic fields, thresholds and F/S/physics; Pair7 historically inspected
evaluation.improvement: B mean primary directional relative error <=.90*A for BOTH seeds and no increase qualified failure count; all channels/pairs retained
evaluation.beyond_pair7: same10% mean reduction on original pairs0..6 and fresh independent8pairs, both seeds; fresh all24 qualification required
evaluation.complete: all original static/dynamic/directional/reference/physics/F-S thresholds for both seeds; any failure precludes complete correction and coupled GI
evaluation.scattered: WL63 tagged Pair7 diagnostic + independently tagged fresh population; no tags enter training/calibration
evaluation.cost: same unchanged WL59 fresh-process cost suite per arm; inference/update/GPU plus training overhead; no quality-cost superiority if ineligible

preserve: Original files/checkpoints unchanged; no production adoption, coupled solve before eligibility, retuning or successor
